name: Magenta (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of black and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Magenta (an eagle above black and yellow bars) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Magenta, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by royal decree on 28 May 1933.

features.role: Magenta arms — eagle above black and yellow bars, crowned, within branches
